description: Retention daemon that re-generates attestations for MCPs whose current attestation will expire within 7 days. Pattern: SELECT from mcp_attestations WHERE expires_at < NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days'. On each row, calls trust_synthesiser (via direct function import, not HTTP) to recompute composite, then writes updated attestation row. Heartbeat every 60s to service_health. Must not DROP or DELETE any row. Follows base pattern from retention_sweeper.py.
